account.title: My account
account.identity_note: Your name, your sign-in e-mail and your role are changed by administration.
account.password_never: Still the one the account was created with.
account.password_rule_match: Both times you type it match
account.password_saved_toast: Password changed on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.mfa_required_hint: Your role moves money and permissions: two-step verification comes with the post and cannot be turned off.
account.mfa_optional_hint: A temporary code from an authenticator app, on top of your password.
account.mfa_required_missing: Your role requires it. Turn it on now so you are not locked out of the panel.
account.mfa_enroll_body: Add the account to your app with this key and type the six-digit code it shows.
account.mfa_enabled_toast: Verification turned on on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.mfa_disabled_toast: Verification turned off on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.mfa_recovery_left: {count, plural, one {# unused code} other {# unused codes}} to get in if you lose your phone.
account.mfa_recovery_note: Keep them off the phone. Each one works once, and the previous ones stop working.
account.mfa_recovery_toast: Codes generated on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.sessions_subtitle: Where your account is open right now. If you do not recognise one, close it and change your password.
account.sessions_closed_toast: Session closed on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.sessions_closed_others_toast: The other sessions were closed on screen only. There is no server behind this yet.
account.sessions_only_current: There is no other session open besides this one.
account.language_hint: Changes the language of the whole interface. It applies right away.
account.audit_notice: Every password change, two-step verification change and closed session is written to the append-only audit log.

dashboard.subtitle: Today at a glance, plus everything waiting on a human.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Receipts the AI could not approve on its own. Reviewed oldest first.
review.empty_body: When a receipt needs a human, it shows up here.

seats.title: Seats per class group
seats.subtitle: Groups closest to filling up in this sales period.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Everything the panel manages. We are enabling them in stages.
modules.students: Full file, status, enrollment history and data editing.
modules.enrollments: Enrollments by period, class group and status, with seat reservation.
modules.payments: Receipts, approval, rejection and validation tolerance.
modules.courses: Courses, class groups, schedules, seats and start dates.
modules.teachers: Teachers and the class groups each one owns.
modules.email: Transactional emails and campaigns, with versioned templates.
modules.reports: Enrollments, revenue and occupancy by course and period.
modules.settings: Sales periods, current prices and validation parameters.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Search by name, ID, email or phone.
students.empty_body: Try another name, ID or email, or clear the status filter.
students.locked_title: No access to the student directory
students.locked_body: You reach a student through your own class group. The full list belongs to coordination.

new_student.title: New student
new_student.subtitle: For the student whose sale closed on WhatsApp and who is not on the platform yet. Registering them is what opens their file; the enrollment comes after.
new_student.guardian_optional: Optional while the student is of age.
new_student.guardian_required_minor: The student is a minor: the guardian is required.
new_student.consent_notice: Consent (Ley 29733) is not written from here: the guardian accepts it, and it keeps their date, their version and their IP. The file starts with consent pending.
new_student.created_local_only: Student registered on screen only. No server is wired yet.
new_student.missing_fields: Fill in the required fields to register the student.

student_file.edit_audit_notice: Every data change is recorded with author, timestamp and previous value.
student_file.saved_local_only: Changes applied on screen only ({time}). No server is wired yet.
student_file.guardian_consent_locked: Consent is not edited here: it is recorded when the guardian accepts the current text. Every data change keeps author, date and previous value.
student_file.consent_missing_detail: The student is a minor and the guardian has not accepted the current text yet.
student_file.no_guardian_body: The student is of age, so no guardian is required.
student_file.no_enrollments_body: This student has no enrollment on record yet.
student_file.no_documents_body: Enrollment certificates and diplomas show up here once issued.
student_file.activity_subtitle: Append-only record: nothing is edited or deleted.
student_file.no_activity_body: No actions have been recorded for this student yet.
student_file.issue_email_notice: Issuing sends the e-mail on its own. There is no separate send button.
student_file.issue_fee_notice: The constancia costs {amount} and is charged separately. Only issue it once the payment is verified.
student_file.issued_local_only: Document issued on screen only ({time}). No server connected yet.
student_file.resent_local_only: Resend recorded on screen only ({time}). No server connected yet.
student_file.request_hint: The constancia is issued once the fee payment is approved.
student_file.no_attachments_body: Files the student uploads from the portal and files staff attach here show up in this list.
student_file.attachments_hint: Attached files, not institution documents: they carry no verification code.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Everything paid for an enrollment or a procedure, with the state of each receipt.
payments.metric_rejected_hint: The seat goes back to the pool
payments.empty_body: Every enrollment and every paid procedure lands here, wherever it came from.
payments.empty_search_body: Try another student, course or operation number, or clear the filters.
payments.locked_body: Receipts are settled by treasury. Your side of the panel is the class group.

receipt_review.subtitle: Submitted {date} · {course}
receipt_review.image_placeholder: The image arrives through a 5-minute signed link. No storage is wired yet.
receipt_review.image_note: We keep the processed version, never the original file.
receipt_review.second_opinion_note: What settles it is the two agreeing, never the more expensive model.
receipt_review.duplicate_title: The same image was already used
receipt_review.reject_note_placeholder: What a colleague would need to know to understand the decision.
receipt_review.audit_notice: The decision is recorded with author, date and reason, and cannot be undone.
receipt_review.duplicate_warning: This receipt is flagged as a repeat: approving it charges the same image twice.
receipt_review.approved_toast: Approved on screen only. No server is connected yet.
receipt_review.rejected_toast: Rejected on screen only. No server is connected yet.
receipt_review.empty_body: Pick a receipt from the queue to see it next to what the AI read.

rejection_reason.not_a_receipt: The image is not a receipt

payment_settings.title: Receipt validation
payment_settings.subtitle: The parameters the platform approves on before it asks for a human.
payment_settings.tolerance_hint: How far a receipt may fall from the plan price and still pass on its own.
payment_settings.confidence_hint: Below this value on a critical field the receipt is escalated instead of approved.
payment_settings.reservation_hint: Days a seat stays reserved with no approved payment. After that it is released.
payment_settings.checkout_hold_hint: Minutes the public enrolment holds a seat while the student goes off to pay. When it runs out the seat goes back to the class group and they pick a schedule again.
payment_settings.saved_toast: Parameters applied on screen only. No server is connected yet.
payment_settings.audit_notice: Changing a parameter applies to receipts arriving afterwards: it never revalidates a payment already settled.
payment_settings.locked_body: These parameters decide what gets approved unseen. Only whoever administers the platform changes them.

enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.subtitle: Every seat in the institution: who enrolled, in which class group, and whether the payment is settled.
enrollments.metric_reserved_hint: {count, plural, one {# expires within 24 h} other {# expire within 24 h}}
enrollments.metric_released_hint: Handed back to the class group
enrollments.search_placeholder: Code, student, course, class group or operation number
enrollments.empty_body: Every student holding a seat shows up here, whether they came from the form or from the panel.
enrollments.empty_search_body: Try another student, course or class group, or clear the filters.
enrollments.locked_body: Enrollments belong to administration and coordination. Treasury settles the money in Payments; a teacher sees the students of their own class groups, reached through the class group.

enrollment_detail.subtitle: {course} · enrolled on {date}
enrollment_detail.frozen_price: Price frozen at enrollment ({id}). Correcting the price table does not change this enrollment.
enrollment_detail.manage_notice: Moving, freezing or withdrawing the student is a paid procedure, recorded from the class group and not from here.

reservations.title: Reserved seats
reservations.subtitle: Seats held by a payment nobody has settled yet. Closest to expiry first.

reservations.left_hours: {hours, plural, one {# h left} other {# h left}}
reservations.left_days: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
reservations.empty_body: Every taken seat has its payment settled.

new_enrollment.title: New enrollment
new_enrollment.subtitle: For the sale that closed on WhatsApp and never reached the form. The normal way in is the student enrolling at /enrollment.
new_enrollment.no_students_found: No student with those details. A new student is registered from their own file, with the guardian consent record.
new_enrollment.class_group_placeholder: Pick a class group with seats
new_enrollment.no_open_class_groups: No class group is enrolling with seats left.
new_enrollment.price_locked: The plan price in force. Not editable: there are no discounts.
new_enrollment.no_price: This course has no price in force. It cannot be enrolled into without one.
new_enrollment.method_other_placeholder: e.g. deposit at Banco de la Nación
new_enrollment.notice_pending: The seat is reserved and the payment stays open. Once the receipt arrives it joins the same review queue as every other one.
new_enrollment.notice_under_review: The seat is reserved and the receipt joins the review queue. No payment is ever approved from this screen.
new_enrollment.created_local_only: Enrollment created on screen only. No server is wired yet.
new_enrollment.missing_fields: Fill in the required fields to create the enrollment.

class_groups.title: Class groups
class_groups.subtitle: Class groups by period, with what each one still has to issue.

class_groups.empty_body: No class groups have been created for this period yet.
class_groups.group_count: {count, plural, one {# class group} other {# class groups}}
class_groups.pending_warning: {count, plural, one {# with a certificate to issue} other {# with certificates to issue}}
class_groups.empty_search_body: Try another course or teacher, or clear the filters.
class_groups.empty_active_body: Nothing is enrolling or running right now.
class_groups.empty_closed_body: Class groups show up here once they finish.
class_groups.created_local_only: Class group created on screen only ({time}). No server connected yet.
class_groups.own_subtitle: The class groups you teach this period.

class_group.batch_blocked: {count, plural, one {# left out} other {# left out}}

class_group.batch_exam_notice: This course certifies through an exam: whoever did not sit it stays out of the batch.
class_group.batch_none: Nobody is ready to be issued in this class group.
class_group.batch_not_finished: This class group has not finished yet. Certificates go out at the close.
class_group.batch_done_local_only: Batch issued on screen only ({time}). No server connected yet.
class_group.deadline_left: {days, plural, one {# business day left} other {# business days left}}
class_group.deadline_overdue: {days, plural, one {# business day overdue} other {# business days overdue}}

class_group.empty_roster_body: Nobody is enrolled in this class group yet.

enrollment_procedure_rule.freeze: Freeze (enrollment on hold). Not available on Inglés Intermedio/Avanzado.
enrollment_procedure_rule.withdraw: Releases the seat. The rules define no refund of what was paid.

procedure_block.already_applied: This enrollment already went through a procedure.
procedure_block.payment_not_approved: The enrollment payment is not approved yet.
procedure_block.not_offered: This course does not offer the procedure.
procedure_block.no_seats_elsewhere: No other class group of the same course has a free seat.

manage_enrollment.subtitle: Procedures on the enrollment in {classGroup}.
manage_enrollment.paid_outside: Procedures are charged outside the platform, through Atención al Alumno. This records what was already paid and agreed.
manage_enrollment.confirm_fee: I confirm the fee was paid and the receipt approved.
manage_enrollment.confirm_no_fee: I confirm the withdrawal was agreed with the student.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: The catalog class groups are opened from.
courses.class_group_count: {count, plural, =0 {no class groups} one {# class group} other {# class groups}}
courses.empty_body: The catalog has no courses yet.
courses.empty_search_body: Try another course, language or level.
courses.local_only: Changes are screen-only. No server is connected yet.
courses.options_hint: All of this can be changed later in the course options.

course_options.subtitle: Course options · {language}

course_options.active_hint: Taking it out of the catalog does not end running class groups: it just stops being offered.

certificate_rule_hint.automatic: Issued to whoever reaches the minimum grade, with no separate request.
certificate_rule_hint.exam_required: On top of the grade, the student must sit the certification exam.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.subtitle: Who teaches what, who is free, and what is still owed.
teachers.locked_title: No access to the teaching staff
teachers.locked_body: The roster is run by administration and coordination.
teachers.address_hint: The address the contract is signed against. Not the same as origin.
teachers.languages_hint: Languages they may take a class group in. They come from the course catalog.
teachers.empty_body: No teacher matches the search or the filters.
teachers.new_subtitle: Who they are, where they live, what they can teach, and on what contract.
teachers.contract_hint: The signed contract and the window it covers. It can be filed later, but not half-filed.
teachers.contract_alert_hint: The panel warns {days} days before it lapses, and marks the contract expired the moment the date passes.

teachers.contract_dates_out_of_order: The end of the window has to come after its start.

teachers.contract_none_body: No contract is on file for this teacher.
teachers.empty_inactive_body: The whole roster is still active.
teachers.contract_inactive: The contract is only watched while the teacher is active.

teacher_file.no_class_groups_body: This teacher has no class groups allocated yet.

teacher_file.deactivate_class_groups: Careful: {count, plural, one {# running class group still points} other {# running class groups still point}} at them. Reassign them.
teacher_file.deactivated_toast: Teacher made inactive. On screen only.

availability.title: Availability
availability.hint: Windows they can teach in. Class groups are allocated on top of them.
availability.invalid_range: The end comes before the start
